meta.textSample: Home Solutions Why Uplane Resources About Us Careers Login Get Started About Us Building the future of performance marketing AI-first approach to better, faster, and smarter marketing. Founding Story The reason behind our work We’re building Uplane to help marketing teams achieve superior results with significantly less effort, time, and ad spend. Talk to Founders Explore Features We founded Uplane because Marketing desperately needs a revolution. Marketing managers are blocked in slow and endless design cycles. New ads and new landing pages are a constant performance bottleneck. Launching and optimizing campaigns involves countless manual steps in slow and buggy ad management systems. Consumers carry the burden of receiving irrelevant ads every day, and companies even pay billions for that. With Uplane, we fundamentally want to transform the way companies approach performance marketing. Our vision is a marketing engine that operates with true autonomy. A platform that allows you to generate thousands of personalized ads and matching landing pages in seconds, launch them across channels with one click, and autonomously allocate budgets to ensure every penny is invested for maximum impact. We want to give every marketing team an engine that runs hundreds of experiments around the clock, constantly improves, and gets better with every bit of consumer feedback. Founded by a team that has lived the painful inefficiencies of manual marketing and is backed by deep expertise in product development, data analytics and AI, our mission is to give performance marketers true leverage, enabling them to achieve superior results with less effort and spend, and with a whole lot of joy. Leadership We are looking for outstanding talents who want to push the boundaries of Performance Marketing and build nothing less than the future of digital advertising. Julius Korfgen Co-Founder, CEO Lukas Vollmer Co-Founder, CTO Marvin Massih Co-Founder, COO Join Our Team Ready to upgrade your marketing? Ready to upgrade your marketing? meta.textSample: Home Solutions Why Uplane Resources About Us Careers Login Get Started Explore the Platform Every feature built for real performance From research to reporting, everything you need to automate, scale, and optimize performance marketing. Talk to Founders Why Uplane Market Research Start with real-time market intelligence Analyze top-performing ads, trending topics, and competitor strategies to guide your creative direction with data. Uplane gives you instant access to insights no human team could process. Every campaign starts with an edge. Ad Creation Create, iterate, and scale high-performing ads Quickly generate ad variations tailored to your brand, product, and goals. Uplane helps you test broad concepts, discover winners fast, and scale them with hyper-personalized creatives to reduce conversion costs. Landing Pages & Lead Capture Build landing pages that convert faster Deploy custom landing pages that match each ad in seconds. Run automated A/B tests, track every interaction, and sync leads directly to your CRM. Never lose momentum in the funnel. Campaign Launch & Management Launch and manage campaigns with ease Effortlessly go live across multiple channels with brand-safe, compliant ads. Uplane adjusts your budget in real time to maximize ROI. Your money always works where it performs best. Optimization & Learning Engine Campaigns that learn and grow daily Uplane continuously improves your targeting and creatives using performance data. It automatically builds new ads, tests variations, and expands high-performing segments, all while cutting what doesn’t work. Reporting & Insights Get smarter insights without manual work Receive automated reports straight to Slack, Teams, or email. Understand what messaging drives results, and get tailored insights to refine strategy, without crunching a single number. Chat Interface Talk to Uplane like your own team Send ideas, screenshots, or questions in Slack, Teams, or WhatsApp. Watch them turn into campaigns.
